item_short_desc: Rothco’s U.S. Letters Insignia are perfect for anyone active in the military, or someone looking for a pin to show their support for the United States.
description: Rothco’s U.S. Letters Insignia are perfect for anyone active in the military, or someone looking for a pin to show their support for the United States. Certified by the Institute of Heraldry, the officer insignia letters are worn with branch insignia badges. Constructed of 24K gold plated brass, the U.S. insignia letters feature a polished mirror finish and measure 7/16” X 7/8”.
